The spectrometer analysis of the particle cloud shows it matches the material used for the ''Nonvideor''-class minelayers.|Darth Caedus and [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Loccin]], aboard the ''Anakin Solo'' after arriving in Fondorian space|<ref name="Revelation" />}}
The '''''Nonvideor''-class minelayer''' was a small stealth [[Minelayer (starship type)|minelaying]] [[Warship/Legends|warship]], operated by a crew of twenty, that was used by the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance's]] [[Galactic Alliance Defense Fleet|naval]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleets]] during the [[Second Galactic Civil War]]. Equipped with powerful [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrives]] and payloads of [[Space mine/Legends|space mines]], five of the minelayers were deployed by the Galactic Alliance to create a pair of [[Mine/Legends|mine]] rings around the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor]] in [[41 ABY]], but they were destroyed before they could do so after their [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] reversion coordinates were betrayed to the enemy.

==Characteristics==
{{Quote|Complement of twenty per ship?|Galactic Alliance Lieutenant [[Tahiri Veila]] asks Darth Caedus about the crew complement of ''Nonvideor''-class minelayers|<ref name="Revelation" />}}
''Nonvideor''-class [[Minelayer (starship type)|minelayers]] were small [[Warship/Legends|warships]] with stealth capabilities that were equipped with disproportionately strong [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrives]] for their size. Operated by twenty crew members, the minelayer class had a payload of [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn]] [[Vigilante mine|Vigilante]] [[Space mine/Legends|space mines]] that used a network to self-deploy, reducing the [[Time/Legends|time]] that it took to disperse the complement of [[Mine/Legends|mines]], as conventional mine laying was not required. The [[Starship/Legends|vessels]] also had [[Comm unit/Legends|communications systems]], though it was impossible to make contact with a ''Nonvideor''-class minelayer while it was in stealth mode.<ref name="Revelation" />

==Role==
The ''Nonvideor''-class minelayer was used as a warship that could utilize its powerful hyperdrive to arrive close to a target, deploy its complement of mines, and retreat back into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] as quickly as possible. The minelayers' stealth equipment, as well as the self-deploying mines' ability to decrease the time needed for mine laying, aided the starships in completing their missions undetected.<ref name="Revelation" />

==History==
{{Quote|Fondor knew we were coming.''"<br />"''Lieutenant, Fondor knew we were coming for weeks, but they knew where and when we were arriving.|Lieutenant Tahiri Veila and Darth Caedus, after the discovery of the minelayers' destruction|<ref name="Revelation" />}}
''Nonvideor''-class minelayers were adopted for use by the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance's]] [[Galactic Alliance Defense Fleet|navy]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] following the [[Swarm War]],<ref name="TCSWE" /> which ended in [[36 ABY]]. In [[41 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> as the Galactic Alliance engaged the [[Confederation]] and the [[Jedi Coalition]] in the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], Galactic Alliance [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] and [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Caedus]] set his sights on reclaiming the [[Fondor Shipyards/Legends|shipyards]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor]], following the world's secession to the Confederation. In advance of a task force of the [[Fourth Fleet (Galactic Alliance)|Galactic Alliance Fourth Fleet]], five ''Nonvideor''-class minelayers were dispatched to sow a double ring of mines around the entirety of Fondor in order to cut off the planet before the Fourth Fleet commenced its assault a [[Standard week/Legends|week]] after the shells had been laid. The ''Nonvideor''-class minelayers were supposed to be able to deploy their payloads within an [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]] of reaching [[Fondorian]] [[Realspace/Legends|space]].<ref name="Revelation" />

However, co-Chief of State [[Cha Niathal]] betrayed the Galactic Alliance plan for Fondor to [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]. As a result, instead of completing their mission unseen and unscathed, the five minelayers were ambushed at their reversion points as soon as they exited hyperspace to begin their mine laying. All took direct hits from enemy fire, which detonated the mines in their cargo and destroyed the minelayers, [[Death/Legends|killing]] the crew. When the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Anakin Solo (starship)|''Anakin Solo'']] and the task force from the Fourth Fleet arrived at Fondor, they discovered the debris fields of the ''Nonvideor''-class minelayers at the reversion points, and Caedus realized that they had been betrayed. The [[Second Battle of Fondor]] that soon ensued would end with a Jedi Coalition victory and Niathal taking a third of the Galactic Alliance Defense Fleet's strength to the side of the Jedi.<ref name="Revelation" />

==Behind the scenes==
''Nonvideor''-class minelayers first appeared, albeit as debris fields, in [[Karen Traviss]]' ''[[Legacy of the Force: Revelation]]'', the eighth novel in the ''[[Star Wars: Legacy of the Force]]'' series, published in [[2008]]. The minelayer class later received an entry in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', also released in 2008.
